annotations.title: Find the steps behind a priority or value

description: Reads every mapped workflow against one PRIORITY (or VALUE) and proposes the steps that move it (or where the business lives the value), one marked as what holds a priority back. Proposals wait for a person to keep them on the priority's page or in the Inbox, except in workflows someone tied to it (a serves link), where they're kept at once. Steps already tied or proposed aren't proposed again, so it's safe to run as the map grows. Use it after a priority is named and workflows are mapped, or when someone asks what moves a priority.

pageId.description: The PRIORITY or VALUE page id.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Ignored for workspace API keys.
